rulings.legal_rule: Each independently operative authored limb is one proposition. Each limb retains its own standard, conditions and exceptions.
rulings.user_note: Each limb has its own standard. Each limb should track its own standard.

rulings.legal_rule: Save each legal fact once under its proper family. Other families may display that fact through a stable link.
rulings.user_note: Agreed after clarification that this concerns duplicate storage across families, not separate limb standards.

rulings.legal_rule: Do not infer a required role from missing or ambiguous support. Fail and flag only the dependent proposition.
